title: Readability plugin configuration
description: Configuration for the readability Claude Code plugin. Place it in .readability.json or .claude/readability.json at the project root, or ~/.claude/readability.json for user defaults. Precedence: built-in defaults < user file < project file < READABILITY_MODE / READABILITY_FEEDBACK environment variables.

documentationPolicy.description: auto: follow discovered linter requirements, otherwise allow non-restating public docs in balanced mode. allow: always allow documentation for this kind. restrict: only allow documentation required by a linter or tagged as an exception.

ruleMap.description: Map from tool key (for example eslint, typescript, ruff, pylint, rubocop, golangci, clang-tidy) or * to rule globs.

exclude.description: Path globs, relative to the project root, that are never checked.

useDefaultExcludes.description: Skip vendored, generated, and dependency directories such as node_modules, vendor, dist, and build.

languages.description: Per-language overrides keyed by language id (typescript, tsx, python, go, ...) or family (javascript, c, ...). Values accept the same keys as the top level.

tags.description: Tags such as SAFETY: that mark a comment as carrying information code cannot express.

allowExternalReferences.description: Allow comments that link an issue, specification, or advisory. null means: true except in strict mode.

pattern.description: Regular expression matched against the comment body (without the comment marker).

new.description: Policy for newly added suppressions. auto: deny in strict, justify in balanced, allow in advisory.

protectConfigFiles.description: Ask before edits to this configuration file or linter configs that weaken documentation requirements.
